Name: Artisan Coffee Oil and Vinegar
Author: voiddreams
Description:
Changes the category of coffee, oil, and vinegar to match other artisan goods.
This is a relatively minor tweak, mostly meant to help those with the Artisan perk or people who are just a bit bothered by the inconsistency!

COMPATIBILITY:
- No known incompatibilities
- Since it only changes the category, not any IDs, it shouldn't negatively impact other mods that affect coffee, oil, or vinegar.
